text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan successfully made her Debut.
Back in the waiting room, she seemed so composed
that it was hard to believe she had just raced—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah, getting so many reactions~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Remember how I updated Umastagram before the race?
That post got so many reactions
and comments!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by Curren Chan,
I took a look at her post...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I watched!" "Great job out there!"
"Your Make Debut was amazing!"
choice_data_list: Looks like you had people rooting for you.
Looks like you had people cheering you on.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm so happy~!
Knowing my fans are watching makes me really want to live up to everyone's expectations~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“Still... looks like we can't just be celebrating.
Take a look at the latest comments too.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, Curren was running?" "Didn't know she was in it."
"Pass on the races." "Please post new outfits instead! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, it feels like the vast majority of people just don't care, rather than leaving supportive comments.
Well, it's only her debut race, so it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still... from here on out, I need to get people
to pay even more attention to "Curren the Runner."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Of course, not just my fans.
People who love racing, people who aren't interested yet... I want everyone to see Curren.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For someone who said, “I want to show
everyone how cute Curren is”... comments lacking
enthusiasm must feel rather unsatisfactory.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So you see, Big Brother.
Curren wants to work on getting more famous for a while!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So you see, Big Sister.
Curren wants to work on getting more famous for a while!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because even if I run, it'd be such a waste
if a ton of people weren't there to watch!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So first, I want to spread the word
that Curren is running in races.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Either way, wouldn't this be the right time to focus on training
for a while to stretch your distance?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then wouldn't that leave us
some time to promote Curren?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: True, as long as her goals are the "Triple Tiara" and "getting known by lots of people," there's no need to pick a target race right away.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's my big brother, you always understand♪
Let's really show off and promote lots from now on!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's my big sister, you always understand♪
Let's really show off and promote lots from now on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, as an initial plan,
we decided to focus on raising Curren Chan's
profile while continuing her training!"
